## File: backend/app/db.py ```python """SQLite access: connections, the ``get_db`` dependency and schema migrations. The application uses the standard library's :mod:`sqlite3` directly. There is no ORM: queries are short and explicit, and every value goes through a ``?`` placeholder so that user input can never change the meaning of a statement. Connections ----------- Endpoints never open connections. They declare a dependency:: @router.get("/things") def list_things(conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)): rows = conn.execute("SELECT id, name FROM things").fetchall() ``get_db`` hands out a connection whose rows are :class:`sqlite3.Row` objects (columns readable by name, ``row["name"]``) and with foreign keys enforced. The work done during one request is committed when the endpoint returns normally and rolled back if it raises. Migrations ---------- The schema is defined by :data:`MIGRATIONS`, a list of SQL scripts applied in order. The number of scripts already applied is stored in SQLite's ``user_version`` pragma, so :func:`init_db` only runs the new ones. To change the schema, **append** a script; never edit or reorder the existing entries, because databases in use have already run them. """ from __future__ import annotations import sqlite3 import threading from collections.abc import Iterator from datetime import datetime, timezone MIGRATIONS: list[str] = [ """ CREATE TABLE users ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL ); """, """ CREATE TABLE audit_log ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, event TEXT NOT NULL, detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL ); CREATE INDEX audit_log_user ON audit_log(user_id, created_at); """, """ CREATE TABLE todos ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, title TEXT NOT NULL, done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL ); CREATE INDEX todos_user ON todos(user_id, created_at DESC); """, ] def utc_now() -> str: """The current time in UTC as an ISO 8601 string, e.g. ``2026-11-24T12:00:00+00:00``. All timestamps are stored in this form. Strings in this format sort in the same order as the times they represent, so ``ORDER BY created_at`` works. """ return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds") def connect(path: str) -> sqlite3.Connection: """Open a connection configured the way the application expects. * rows are :class:`sqlite3.Row`, so columns can be read by name; * foreign key constraints are enforced (SQLite leaves them off by default); * ``check_same_thread`` is off because FastAPI may run a request's dependencies and endpoint in different worker threads. Each connection is still used by one request at a time. """ conn = sqlite3.connect(path, check_same_thread=False) conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON") return conn def schema_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int: """How many entries of :data:`MIGRATIONS` have been applied to this database.""" return int(conn.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0]) def init_db(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int: """Apply the migrations this database has not run yet; return how many ran. Each script runs in its own transaction together with the update of ``user_version``, so a failing script leaves the database at the previous version instead of half migrated. """ applied = 0 for number, script in enumerate(MIGRATIONS, start=1): if number <= schema_version(conn): continue with conn: conn.executescript(f"BEGIN;\n{script}\nPRAGMA user_version = {number};\nCOMMIT;") applied += 1 return applied class Database: """Owns the database of one application instance. For a file database every request gets its own connection. An in-memory database (``":memory:"``) exists only as long as its connection, so in that case a single shared connection is kept for the life of the application and access to it is serialised with a lock. """ def __init__(self, path: str) -> None: self.path = path self._shared: sqlite3.Connection | None = None self._lock = threading.Lock() if path == ":memory:": self._shared = connect(path) init_db(self._shared) else: with connect(path) as conn: init_db(conn) def connections(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]: """Yield one connection for a request, committing or rolling back afterwards.""" if self._shared is not None: with self._lock: try: yield self._shared self._shared.commit() except BaseException: self._shared.rollback() raise return conn = connect(self.path) try: yield conn conn.commit() except BaseException: conn.rollback() raise finally: conn.close() _database: Database | None = None def configure(database: Database) -> None: """Make ``database`` the one :func:`get_db` hands connections from.""" global _database _database = database def get_db() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]: """FastAPI dependency: a connection for the current request. Usage:: def endpoint(conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)): ... Raises: RuntimeError: if the application was not created through :func:`app.main.create_app`, which configures the database. """ if _database is None: raise RuntimeError("database not configured: create the app with create_app()") yield from _database.connections() def audit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, event: str, user_id: int | None = None, detail: str = "") -> None: """Record a security-relevant event in ``audit_log``. Use short event names such as ``"login"``, ``"login_failed"`` or ``"register"``. ``detail`` is free text for humans; never put passwords or tokens in it. """ conn.execute( "INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, event, detail, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)", (user_id, event, detail, utc_now()), ) def row_to_dict(row: sqlite3.Row | None) -> dict[str, object] | None: """Turn a row into a plain dict (or keep ``None``), e.g. to return it as JSON.""" return None if row is None else {key: row[key] for key in row.keys()} ``` ## File: backend/app/routers/auth.py ```python """Authentication endpoints: register, login, current user.""" from __future__ import annotations import re import sqlite3 from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, status from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from app.config import Settings, get_settings from app.db import get_db, utc_now from app.errors import bad_request, conflict, unauthorized from app.security import ( CurrentUser, create_access_token, get_current_user, hash_password, password_problem, verify_password, ) router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/auth", tags=["auth"]) USERNAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,32}$") MAX_TITLE_LENGTH = 200 class RegisterRequest(BaseModel): username: str = Field(..., min_length=1) password: str = Field(..., min_length=1) class RegisterResponse(BaseModel): id: int username: str created_at: str class LoginRequest(BaseModel): username: str = Field(..., min_length=1) password: str = Field(..., min_length=1) class LoginResponse(BaseModel): access_token: str token_type: str = "bearer" expires_in: int class MeResponse(BaseModel): id: int username: str @router.post( "/register", response_model=RegisterResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED, summary="Create a new account", ) def register( data: RegisterRequest, conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db), settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings), ) -> RegisterResponse: username = data.username.strip() password = data.password if not USERNAME_RE.fullmatch(username): raise bad_request( "invalid_username", "Username must be 3-32 characters and contain only letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.", ) problem = password_problem(password) if problem: raise bad_request("weak_password", problem) existing = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ?", (username,)).fetchone() if existing: raise conflict("username_taken", "This username is already taken.") now = utc_now() password_hash = hash_password(password) cursor = conn.execute( "INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (username, password_hash, now), ) user_id = cursor.lastrowid audit(conn, "register", user_id, f"username={username}") return RegisterResponse(id=user_id, username=username, created_at=now) @router.post("/login", response_model=LoginResponse, summary="Sign in and get an access token") def login( data: LoginRequest, conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db), settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings), ) -> LoginResponse: username = data.username.strip() password = data.password row = conn.execute("SELECT id, password_hash FROM users WHERE username = ?", (username,)).fetchone() if row is None or not verify_password(password, row["password_hash"]): audit(conn, "login_failed", None, f"username={username}") raise unauthorized("invalid_credentials", "Invalid username or password.") user_id = row["id"] audit(conn, "login", user_id, f"username={username}") token = create_access_token(user_id, username, settings) return LoginResponse(access_token=token, expires_in=settings.token_ttl) @router.get("/me", response_model=MeResponse, summary="Current signed-in user") def me(user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user)) -> MeResponse: return MeResponse(id=user.id, username=user.username) ``` ## File: backend/app/routers/todos.py ```python"""Todo endpoints for the signed-in user.""" from __future__ import annotations import sqlite3 from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Path, Query, status from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from app.config import Settings, get_settings from app.db import get_db, utc_now from app.errors import not_found from app.pagination import PageParams, page_params, paginate from app.security import CurrentUser, get_current_user router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/todos", tags=["todos"]) MAX_TITLE_LENGTH = 200 class TodoCreate(BaseModel): title: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=MAX_TITLE_LENGTH) class TodoUpdate(BaseModel): title: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=MAX_TITLE_LENGTH) done: bool | None = None class TodoResponse(BaseModel): id: int title: str done: bool created_at: str updated_at: str class TodoListResponse(BaseModel): items: list[TodoResponse] total: int limit: int offset: int def _todo_row_to_response(row: sqlite3.Row) -> TodoResponse: return TodoResponse( id=row["id"], title=row["title"], done=bool(row["done"]), created_at=row["created_at"], updated_at=row["updated_at"], ) @router.get("", response_model=TodoListResponse, summary="List the current user's todos") def list_todos( done: bool | None = Query(default=None, description="Filter by done status"), page: PageParams = Depends(page_params), user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user), conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db), ) -> TodoListResponse: where = ["user_id = ?"] params: list[object] = [user.id] if done is not None: where.append("done = ?") params.append(1 if done else 0) where_sql = " AND ".join(where) total = conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos WHERE {where_sql}", params).fetchone()[0] rows = conn.execute( f"SELECT id, title, done, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE {where_sql} " f"ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?", (*params, page.limit, page.offset), ).fetchall() items = [_todo_row_to_response(row) for row in rows] return paginate(items, total, page) @router.post( "", response_model=TodoResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED, summary="Create a new todo", ) def create_todo( data: TodoCreate, user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user), conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db), ) -> TodoResponse: title = data.title.strip() now = utc_now() cursor = conn.execute( "INSERT INTO todos (user_id, title, done, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, 0, ?, ?)", (user.id, title, now, now), ) todo_id = cursor.lastrowid row = conn.execute( "SELECT id, title, done, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,), ).fetchone() return _todo_row_to_response(row) @router.get("/{todo_id}", response_model=TodoResponse, summary="Get a single todo") def get_todo( todo_id: int = Path(..., ge=1), user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user), conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db), ) -> TodoResponse: row = conn.execute( "SELECT id, title, done, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", (todo_id, user.id), ).fetchone() if row is None: raise not_found("todo_not_found", f"Todo {todo_id} does not exist.") return _todo_row_to_response(row) @router.patch("/{todo_id}", response_model=TodoResponse, summary="Update a todo") def update_todo( data: TodoUpdate, todo_id: int = Path(..., ge=1), user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user), conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db), ) -> TodoResponse: row = conn.execute( "SELECT id, title, done, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", (todo_id, user.id), ).fetchone() if row is None: raise not_found("todo_not_found", f"Todo {todo_id} does not exist.") title = data.title.strip() if data.title is not None else row["title"] done = 1 if data.done else 0 if data.done is not None else row["done"] now = utc_now() conn.execute( "UPDATE todos SET title = ?, done = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?", (title, done, now, todo_id), ) row = conn.execute( "SELECT id, title, done, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,), ).fetchone() return _todo_row_to_response(row) @router.delete("/{todo_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT, summary="Delete a todo") def delete_todo( todo_id: int = Path(..., ge=1), user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user), conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db), ) -> None: cursor = conn.execute( "DELETE FROM todos WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?", (todo_id, user.id), ) if cursor.rowcount == 0: raise not_found("todo_not_found", f"Todo {todo_id} does not exist.") ``` ## File: backend/app/main.py ```python """The application factory. ``uvicorn --factory app.main:build`` serves an application built from environment settings. Tests and scripts call :func:`create_app` with explicit values instead:: app = create_app(db_path=":memory:", secret="test") Adding a feature means writing a router module in :mod:`app.routers` and adding one ``app.include_router(...)`` line below. """ from __future__ import annotations from pathlib import Path from fastapi import FastAPI from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from app import __version__, errors from app.config import Settings, get_settings, settings_from_env from app.db import Database, configure from app.routers import auth, health, todos FRONTEND_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "frontend" def create_app( settings: Settings | None = None, *, db_path: str | None = None, secret: str | None = None, ) -> FastAPI: """Build a configured application. Args: settings: Complete settings. Read from the environment when omitted. db_path: Shortcut that overrides ``settings.db_path`` (tests use ``":memory:"``). secret: Shortcut that overrides ``settings.secret``. The database is opened and migrated here, so the application is ready to serve requests as soon as this returns. """ if settings is None: settings = Settings(secret=secret or "") if secret is not None else settings_from_env() if db_path is not None or secret is not None: settings = Settings( db_path=db_path or settings.db_path, secret=secret or settings.secret, token_ttl=settings.token_ttl, cors_origins=settings.cors_origins, page_size=settings.page_size, max_page_size=settings.max_page_size, ) settings.validate() app = FastAPI(title="Taskboard", version=__version__) app.dependency_overrides[get_settings] = lambda: settings configure(Database(settings.db_path)) errors.install(app) if settings.cors_origins: app.add_middleware( CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=list(settings.cors_origins), allow_methods=["GET", "POST", "PATCH", "DELETE"], allow_headers=["Authorization", "Content-Type"], ) app.include_router(health.router) app.include_router(auth.router) app.include_router(todos.router) if FRONTEND_DIR.is_dir(): app.mount("/", StaticFiles(directory=FRONTEND_DIR, html=True), name="frontend") return app def build() -> FastAPI: """Entry point for ``uvicorn --factory app.main:build``: settings from the environment. A factory instead of a module-level ``app`` means importing this module never needs ``APP_SECRET``, which keeps imports in tests side-effect free. """ return create_app() ``` ## File: frontend/login.html ```html Sign in – Taskboard
